projects.name: ProofChain
projects.description: Blockchain-verified digital evidence management platform with AI tamper detection.
projects.problem: Digital evidence can be easily tampered with — courts and investigations need proof that a file hasn't been altered since submission.
projects.approach: Solely architected a publicly deployed forensic evidence platform (40 API endpoints, email-verified auth, 3 roles). An EVM smart contract (Solidity, Ethers.js) anchors SHA-256 hashes and IPFS CIDs on Polygon, with a zero-trust re-hashing verification API. A containerized FastAPI microservice runs a 12-signal composite tamper-scoring algorithm (Vision Transformer, Gemini Vision API, EXIF/MIME/PDF/video forensics).
projects.result: End-to-end tamper-proof evidence chain: upload → AI analysis → IPFS storage → blockchain anchoring → verifiable certificate. Secured with JWT (15-min access/7-day refresh), TOTP 2FA, brute-force lockout, and timing-attack mitigation; validated with 34 automated pytest test cases and a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with automated Vercel deployment.
highlights: Polygon smart contract anchoring SHA-256 hashes and IPFS CIDs for immutable records
12-signal AI tamper-scoring (Vision Transformer, Gemini Vision, forensic analysis)
40 API endpoints with email-verified auth, 3 roles, JWT + TOTP 2FA
Fire-and-forget async pipelines for AI scoring and blockchain anchoring

projects.name: CodSach Student Hub
projects.description: Academic resource platform for MCA students, built as a Git-backed headless CMS.
projects.problem: Academic materials were scattered across WhatsApp groups and random drives — no version control, search, or structure for MCA students.
projects.approach: Solely designed and built a Next.js + TypeScript platform that uses the GitHub REST API as a zero-cost database, serving 4 resource categories across 8 pages with recursive Git-tree traversal and parallel blob fetching. Type-safe server-side pipelines (Genkit flows, Zod validation) with tag-based cache invalidation for real-time updates.
projects.result: Centralized academic hub organized by category with search, multi-criteria filtering, and an admin panel with GitHub-token authentication; automated lint, typecheck, and build via GitHub Actions with Vercel deployment.
highlights: Git-backed resource storage with version control
Genkit AI-powered backend flows with Zod validation
Admin panel with GitHub-token authentication and multi-criteria filtering

projects.name: TaskManager
projects.description: Full-stack task management app with ShadCN UI and MongoDB.
projects.problem: Most student task management tools rely on local storage or basic Firebase — needed a production-quality solution with proper database persistence.
projects.approach: Built with Next.js App Router, ShadCN UI for accessible components, full TypeScript coverage, and MongoDB for persistent CRUD operations.
projects.result: Production-ready task manager showcasing full-stack Next.js patterns with database integration and polished component design.
